project: Agent RL for Diffusion Language Models
success_criteria: Agent RL (TraceRL + tools) accuracy > standard RL (no tools) on GSM8K eval
Tool call rate increases over training steps
Segment-aware masking ablation shows it is necessary (removing it hurts)
Pipeline runs stably for 30+ steps without divergence

tasks.name: Baseline: LLaDA-8B zero-shot eval
tasks.description: Evaluate LLaDA-8B-Base zero-shot on GSM8K test (200 samples) and MATH500 (100 samples). No RL, no tools. Establishes the floor.

tasks.name: Baseline: Standard single-turn RL (no tools)
tasks.description: Train LLaDA-8B with standard TraceRL on GSM8K (no tool access). 30 steps, same hyperparams. Compare against agent RL to isolate tool-use benefit.

tasks.name: Main: Agent RL with TraceRL + calculator
tasks.description: Train LLaDA-8B with agent RL (calculator tool, segment-aware TraceRL masking). 30 steps on GSM8K. Eval on GSM8K test + MATH500. Core result.

tasks.name: Comparison: Agent RL with random masking
tasks.description: Same as 004 but use random_masking instead of TraceRL. Isolates the effect of trajectory-aware credit assignment.

tasks.name: Ablation: Remove segment-aware masking
tasks.description: Same as 004 but train on ALL tokens (including observation tokens). Validates that segment-aware masking is critical.

tasks.name: Analysis: Learning curves and tool usage
tasks.description: Extract per-step metrics from experiments 003/004/005/006: accuracy, tool call rate, loss, reward variance. Generate plots.

tasks.name: Visualization and paper writing
tasks.description: Create all figures/tables. Write workshop paper draft.
